settings.description: Community Perception of Hazards, Vulnerability, Coping Mechanism

labels: **Informed consent:**  My name is ${enum_name} and I am working with Uganda Red Cross in partenership with IFRC. We are conducting a survey which aims to capture community perceptions, experiences, and behavioural dynamics to complement the existing humanitarian information sources. I will need only 10-15 minutes of your time, and you can decide whether you would like to participate in this survey ?

We will save all data and may share results with other partners, in an effort to learn and provide better services. NO personal identifiable information will be collected, and the information cannot be traced back to you. Would you like to participate in this survey, giving permission to save and share non-personal information

survey.name: consent_refused
label: Thank the respondent for their time and end the interview here. Submit the form as it is - a refusal is data too.

hint: Take the reading outside, away from walls. Do not record a GPS point inside a shelter.
survey.name: hh_gps
label: Record the GPS location

survey.name: hh_head
label: Are you the head of the household?

survey.name: who_hh_head
label: Who is the head of the household?

survey.name: hh_composition
label: How many people live in your household? (including yourself)
survey.constraint_message: number of people has to be more than 1

survey.name: hh_demographics
label: What is the demography of your household?

survey.name: meaning_hazard
label: What does a hazard mean to you?

survey.name: hazards_experience
label: What hazards has this community been experiencing?

survey.name: hazard_kind
label: What hazards have become more severe/frequent in the recent years?
survey.constraint_message: Please select a maximum of 3 hazards (top 3).

survey.name: hazard_impact
label: How seriously does ${hazard_name} affect your household/community?

survey.name: hazard_affected_groups
label: Which groups experience the greatest impact?

survey.name: hazard_cause
label: What are the main causes of these hazards?

survey.name: hazard_measures
label: What measures do you take to be resistant towards common hazards?
survey.constraint_message: you said "No Specific Measure" or "I don't know"

survey.name: hazard_management
label: What hazard management capacities do you have in this community?

survey.name: hazard_evacuate
label: Where do people go when they need to leave their homes?

survey.name: meaning_vulnerability
label: What does vulnerability mean to you?

survey.name: vulnerabilities_believe
label: What vulnerabilities do you believe the community is facing?

survey.name: vulnerabilities_group
label: What makes some groups more vulnerable than others?

survey.name: vulnerabilities_differences
label: Are there any differences between people who arrived recently and longer-term residents?

survey.name: meaning_coping
label: What does coping capacity mean to you?

survey.name: coping_challenges
label: What gaps/challenges do you think your community has with regard to ${coping_hazard_name}?

survey.name: coping_extent
label: To what extent do you think your community can cope with a hazard?

survey.name: coping_cohesion
label: What capacities do you have in this community with regard to social cohesion?

survey.name: coping_gaps
label: What vulnerabilities (gaps and challenges) do you have in this community with regard to social cohesion?

survey.name: fgd_consent
label: Does the group provide consent for Audio recording?

survey.name: fgd_target_group
label: Which group is the Focused Group Discussion for?

survey.name: fgd_no_consent
label: The group has not consented to audio recording. **End the form here and record the responses on paper.**

survey.name: kii_consent
label: Does the Key informant provide Consent for Audio Recording?

survey.name: kii_years_community
label: Years in this Community?
survey.constraint_message: Enter a whole number of years between 0 and 4.

survey.name: kii_no_consent
label: The key informant has not consented to audio recording. **End the form here and record the responses on paper.**
